name: Filmcasino
notes:
server-rendered day tables at /programm/?show=this (next 7 days) and /programm/?show=next (following week, ~6 days currently); showtimes only, no year in markup (inferred from today's date); price never published so price_min always null; category is the site's own 'special' series label (e.g. Queer Frames, Park Chan-wook) when present, else null; image and runtime now fetched from each film's own detail page (one ThreadPoolExecutor pass over the ~25 unique urls, 10 workers): image is the first (the article header still, 100% fill observed), runtime is the '| NN min |' token right after the

title line, stored as extra.duration_min (100% fill) for the pipeline's automatic end derivation; no direct end time is published so end stays null
